nodes.label: desktop memory - a bare share is context to reconcile, not a prompt to generate on

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. When the user shows something without an explicit question or request, it is CONTEXT - a pointer to related material already in the conversation and the repo - not a prompt to generate upon. He repeatedly got mess and drift because agents generated upon what he shared instead of reconciling it against current reality; a share means hold this against what we already have and tell me what it changes, not produce a new thing. On any share with no explicit ask: re-ground in current information first by actually reading the relevant repo files AND recalling the conversation thread, checking both and never answering from memory or assumption; reconcile the new input against that context; report only what it changes - a difference, an updated idea, or a fault in prior reasoning - short, in plain English; and write nothing to disk, producing artifacts only when an actual question is posed. CANON_AUDIT.md lists this among the grounded, verbatim-quoted and correct desktop entries
